Name: OmniFarmEx
Author: GlimmerDev
Description:
[b]OmniFarmEx[/b] is an mod for Stardew Valley which vastly expands the Wilderness farm map, and adds extra functionality. This is a continuation of [url=https://github.com/lambui/StardewValleyMod_OmniFarm]OmniFarm[/url], a legacy mod by [b]lambui[/b].

This version aims to revamp the mod by cleaning up map files, [b]making it a separate farm type[/b], and converting it to work with Content Patcher and modern SMAPI.

In addition to a massive amount of farmland (perfect for large multiplayer games!), the map includes elements of other farm types: a mine, regenerating stumps, river fish, and even a minecart stop. There is also an optional farm cave which adds even more land.

[size=5]Install[/size]

[list=1]
[*] Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.

[*]Download the mod.
[*]Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley "Mods/" folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
To uninstall, just delete the mod from Mods folder.

[size=5]Configuration
[/size]
The mod will generate a "config.json" upon launching the game for the first time. The following options are available:

[b]UseOptionalCave[/b]
Whether or not to use the expanded Farm cave or not.
Defaults to [i]false.
[/i]
[b]AddFarmMinecartDest[/b]
Whether or not to add the Farm as a destination on the minecart network. Provided for legacy reasons, as the original mod does not do this.
Default[i]s to true[/i].

To reset the config, simply delete "config.json" in the mod's folder.


A huge thank you to lambui (also known as PhthaloBlue) for creating OmniFarm! Without them, this mod would not exist.
